metadata.title: Area gaps for minimal surfaces in spheres
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove that a linearly full minimal $2$-torus in $\mathbb{S}^N$ with $N\geq 5$ must have area $>2\pi^2$, and that a linearly full closed minimal surface in $\mathbb{S}^N$ with $N\geq 9$ must have area $>8\pi$. These results verify the Willmore conjecture and the generalized Willmore conjecture in higher codimension for minimal surfaces. The area gaps are obtained by applying the Cheng--Li--Yau comparison theorem and deriving a lower bound of the heat trace, where the monotonicity of the shifted normalized Riesz mean is used. We also establish a volume gap above the balanced Clifford product for linearly full closed minimal $n$-submanifolds in $\mathbb{S}^N$ when $n=3$, $N\geq 9$, or $n\geq 4$, $N\geq 3n-1$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 高余维极小曲面的面积隙
analysis.workSummary: 证明线性满极小二维环面在 N≥5 的 S^N 中面积严格大于2π²，线性满闭极小曲面在 N≥9 时面积大于8π；另给指定高维子流形的体积隙。
techniques: 平移正规化 Riesz 均值
analysis.breakthrough: 在极小曲面范围内验证高余维 Willmore 型下界并得到严格隙。
analysis.limitations: 对象是线性满极小浸入及指定余维，不能宣称解决所有非极小曲面的广义 Willmore 猜想。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露在其指导下 ChatGPT 协助数学探索和论文写作，所有辅助内容经作者独立验证；未细分核心想法归属。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28317v1 · 第10页 Declaration on the use of AI

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露在其指导下 ChatGPT 协助数学探索和论文写作，所有辅助内容经作者独立验证；未细分核心想法归属。

analysis.priorityReason: 极小子流形与谱方法的有力交叉，维数条件需保留。
